# Operation support evidence

<!-- Generated by tools/support_matrix.py --write; edit support-ledger.json. -->

This initial inventory records 17 bounded profiles, not complete format parity. All roadmap IDs remain visible below. Statuses cite historical installed-wheel evidence; validation of this file is not a new test run or a completion decision.

Ledger source-audit baseline: `a21fc5c80abe556ac03b471f1906a7ec6b6a3f16`. Historical tests do not certify this source revision. Native adapter/facade changes need their own behavioral review and release validation; matching fixture hashes are only a drift check.

Operations: **read** normalized content; **create** native-format serialization; **edit authored/imported** distinguish model provenance; **preserve** only named unchanged content; **render** PNG; **export** conversion to a named different format. Saving is not conversion.

Statuses: **verified** for the stated scope; **partial** with a stated gap; **unsupported** in the current facade; **blocked upstream** for a cited native constraint; **unassessed** without adequate evidence; **n/a** where the operation has no meaning.

The pinned SDK feature-family crosswalk remains in [API design](authoring-api-design.md). The [pinned reference-family inventory](reference-api-inventory.md) groups representative SDK/PyMuPDF members; complete member dispositions remain unfinished work. No public capability-query API is introduced.

Maintain `docs/support-ledger.json`; run `python tools/support_matrix.py` to check and `python tools/support_matrix.py --write` to regenerate. A changed test-file digest requires review of its assertions/fixture provenance and relevant artifact evidence, not a blind hash refresh. Native citations were source-audited at their immutable pins; the offline checker validates their references, not native code execution or remote symbol existence.

## pdf.region

PNG rendering of a page-view rectangle; not content-stream clipping.

**Public paths:** `open(...).render_page(..., clip=...)`, `open(...)[0].get_pixmap(..., clip=...)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic small PDFs built in test_render_clipping.py with native authoring; explicit CropBox/Rotate/UserUnit dictionaries in the test exercise geometry. PNG samples are decoded by the local test helper, with narrow fixture-specific rounding tolerances. No third-party PDF corpus is implied.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Create | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Edit authored | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Edit imported | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Preserve | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Render | **verified** — Display-space rectangles honor CropBox, rotations and UserUnit; finite/positive/intersection/resource checks. Tested tolerances are fixture-specific, not universal pixel identity. ## word.properties

Strict scalar custom properties, separate from core/extended metadata.

**Public paths:** `open(...).metadata["custom"]`, `new("docx").update_metadata(custom=...)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic DOCX built by the public authoring API; test_imported_properties.py replaces the custom property ZIP part with explicit scalar, malformed, duplicate and oversized XML fixtures. Source patches are test-only, not a runtime parser/writer.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — lpwstr, bool, i8 and finite r8 only; 1024 entries / 64 KiB value / 256 KiB raw aggregate. ASCII-ambiguous names all omitted. Native malformed-part drops and source caps prevent a complete source inventory. ## word.table-alternative-text

Native table caption/description projected as metadata; absent differs from empty.

**Public paths:** `open(...)[0].find_tables()[0].metadata`, `new("docx").add_table(...).format(title=..., description=...)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic authored outer/nested tables plus the local test_docx_stories.py story fixture; the native cap regression patches an authored tblCaption to 10001 Omega characters. Empty and absent values are asserted separately.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — Retained native title/description is exposed at each table depth without adding visible text. Native reader caps each alternative text at 10000 characters. ## pdf.owned-fields

Owned single-widget text/checkbox/choice fields with fixed appearances and bounded Unicode tooltip metadata; no radio/script/multiline profile.

**Public paths:** `new("pdf").pages[0].fields.add(...)`, `field.value`, `field.box`, `field.tooltip`, `pdf.fields.flatten()`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic PDFs authored in test_pdf_fields.py and test_field_geometry.py; the latter uses local PDF geometry fixtures with rotation/CropBox/UserUnit. Assertions inspect actual PNG pixels, metadata, owned copy independence and flattening results. Tooltip fixtures additionally author all three kinds on four rotated CropBox/UserUnit pages, assert owned metadata/copy/readback/clear/resize/value behavior and exact PNG/flatten-control equality. Saved AcroForms still reject editable reopening; native TU roundtrip has separate artifact-level Rust evidence, not an imported-field Python certification.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — Owned field handles expose bounded values/options, current-view geometry and Unicode tooltip metadata; absent/cleared tooltips read as empty strings. This is not imported AcroForm extraction. [PdfFieldTests.test_owned_forms_render_copy_and_flatten](../tests/test_pdf_fields.py); [FieldGeometryTests.test_rotated_cropped_userunit_pages_use_display_coordinates](../tests/test_field_geometry.py); [FieldTooltipTests.test_metadata_preserves_all_kinds_rotated_geometry_pixels_and_followup_edits](../tests/test_field_tooltips.py); [historical artifact: 2026-10-20](../.kiro/specs/rust-document-engine/validation.md#owned-pdf-field-tooltips--complete-local-artifact); [NewField, add_field, set_props, delete_field](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/forms/src/author.rs); [fields_with_adopted, set_value](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/forms/src/lib.rs); [flatten](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/edit/src/flatten.rs); [FieldProps, set_props](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/forms/src/author.rs); [Field](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/forms/src/lib.rs) |

## word.story-clear

**Public paths:** `Section.header(...).clear()`, `Section.footer(...).clear()`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic paragraph/table/image-first stories include nested tables, shared PNGs, page fields and outgoing bookmark links. Native section XML, ownership, copy isolation, decoded PNG colors and PDF page text are asserted; no arbitrary source stories are edited.

## pdf.native-search

Read-only bounded native PDF text rectangles from existing page handles, retaining native text order; rectangles are not normalized block offsets or guaranteed visible-ink regions.

**Public paths:** `Page.search_for(text)`, `PdfPage.search_for(text)`

**Fixture provenance:** Original small PDF byte fixtures define ToUnicode ligatures, ActualText, two columns, reversed text scales and invisible/clipped text; authored Unicode text uses the existing attributed font fixture. Tests inspect native rectangle coordinates/decoded pixels and owned-result/cache lifetimes, not OCR.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **verified** — Case-insensitive literal native matching with normalized whitespace, ligature/ActualText mapping and native column order; CropBox/rotation/UserUnit view boxes. Query limit 4,096 UTF-8 bytes and bounded post-interpretation glyph/match/rectangle work fail rather than truncate. Hidden/clipped text remains searchable; no regex, OCR, visible-only search or Office search. ## word.decimal-outline

Nine-level native decimal hierarchy using existing list assignment, limited to horizontal top-level body paragraphs in unambiguous single-column sections.

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic interleaved numbered/outline hierarchies, all nine levels, explicit starts up to 32767, RTL and empty labels, wrapped paragraphs and failed narrow geometry. Native numbering XML/read metadata is tested separately from PDF labels and decoded source/PDF label-ink bounds. No auxiliary counter or custom-template conformance is claimed.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — Reopened authored fixtures expose native numbering IDs, templates and evaluated labels, separately from source text. This narrow E3 evidence does not certify auxiliary lists, arbitrary imported definitions or ambiguous label placement. ## pdf.comment-locks

Strict boolean native editing lock for canonical notes, four text-markup kinds, rectangles and ellipses. Flag mutation only; no general annotation creation/style or security certification.

**Public paths:** `annotation.locked`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic native-created seven-kind comments use the local rotated CropBox/UserUnit PDF fixture and exact pre/post PNG comparisons, saved reopen, copies and blocked mutation controls. Imported acceptance separately uses the existing minimal canonical rectangle fixture plus saved/reopened native seven-kind output. Malformed/unsupported imported rectangle variants assert unchanged bytes/warm cache. No new geometric creation or foreign appearance regeneration certification.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — Read the native Locked bit for the seven supported comment kinds through existing handles, including stale/closed identity checks. Global imported summaries/initial inspection remain bounded-inventory upstream work; permissive native flag interpretation is not canonical-profile certification. [AnnotationLockTests.test_all_kinds_preserve_pixels_and_metadata_in_rotated_crop_userunit_views](../tests/test_annotation_lock.py); [AnnotationLockTests.test_strict_bool_lifetime_and_page_identity](../tests/test_annotation_lock.py); [AnnotationLockTests.test_imported_profiles_link_exclusion_and_warm_cache_rollback](../tests/test_annotation_lock.py); [historical artifact: 2026-10-20](../.kiro/specs/rust-document-engine/validation.md#annotation-editing-locks--complete-local-artifact); [Summary, summaries, set_locked, set_contents, set_info, move_annotation, set_rect, set_style, delete_annotation](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/annot/src/lib.rs) |
| Create | **n/a** — This profile mutates an existing comment flag. Fixture creation does not certify a new annotation creation API; geometric creation evidence remains in pdf.geometric-comments. |
| Edit authored | **verified** — Toggle the strict boolean within the canonical target profile. Text remains editable; box/color/author/deletion and compound blocked updates fail atomically while locked, then work after unlock. Non-bool inputs never run truth-value callbacks; this does not inhibit document-level operations or grant security. [AnnotationLockTests.test_locked_text_is_editable_but_geometry_style_author_delete_are_atomic](../tests/test_annotation_lock.py); [AnnotationLockTests.test_strict_bool_lifetime_and_page_identity](../tests/test_annotation_lock.py); [historical artifact: 2026-10-20](../.kiro/specs/rust-document-engine/validation.md#annotation-editing-locks--complete-local-artifact); [Summary, summaries, set_locked, set_contents, set_info, move_annotation, set_rect, set_style, delete_annotation](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/annot/src/lib.rs); [Document, update_dict](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/cos/src/document.rs) |
| Edit imported | **partial** — Toggle only the tested canonical imported rectangle and saved/reopened native seven-kind outputs. Malformed flags, nested extensions, replies and noncanonical geometry styles fail atomically in tested rectangle variants; links reject this property. No arbitrary imported note/markup/thread certification. ## pdf.vertical-redaction

Secure removal of vertical-writing text beneath a redaction mark; no public package redaction API currently.

**Public paths:** None; this is an explicit gap.

**Fixture provenance:** No local package fixture because the operation is absent. Native source fixture crates/redact/src/tests.rs::vertical_writing_text_under_a_mark_fails_closed constructs the failure case; inspected at the pinned revision, not rerun by this ledger validation.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **n/a** — This profile concerns removal, not extraction of vertical text. |
| Create | **unsupported** — No current public redaction creation API. |
| Edit authored | **blocked upstream** — Native application explicitly fails closed for vertical-writing text; implementing the general removal guarantee requires upstream geometry work. [RedactError::VerticalText, apply](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/lib.rs); [vertical_writing_text_under_a_mark_fails_closed](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/tests.rs); [U10](../docs/upstream-roadmap.md) |
| Edit imported | **blocked upstream** — Same vertical-writing removal limitation; presence of the native redaction crate does not establish this operation. [RedactError::VerticalText, apply](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/lib.rs); [vertical_writing_text_under_a_mark_fails_closed](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/tests.rs); [U10](../docs/upstream-roadmap.md) |
| Preserve | **unassessed** — No package redaction operation or preservation corpus exists for this profile. |
| Render | **n/a** — An opaque overlay is not evidence that underlying content was removed. |
| Export | **n/a** — A format conversion is not a secure-redaction guarantee. |

**Comparison families:** [REF-PM-REDACTION](reference-api-inventory.md#ref-pm-redaction)
